claims.pass_condition: The appointed verifier can read a copy of each declared produced artifact and cannot read an undeclared output.
claims.primary_surface: Allowed and denied runtime reader calls
claims.counterevidence: An undeclared path returns bytes or verifier mutation changes the runner-owned artifact.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Written output digest equals the independently inspected descriptor digest.
claims.observed_evidence: The documentation verifier read all declared outputs; an escaping verifier was refused, verifier-buffer mutation left runner-owned bytes unchanged, and the denied read failed closed.

claims.pass_condition: The appointed verifier can independently read bytes only from artifacts belonging to declared direct dependencies.
claims.primary_surface: Content verifier reads the source brief and draft through the runner dependency reader
claims.counterevidence: The verifier must trust executor facts or can read an unrelated package artifact.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Package graph and input artifact index bind each read to a verified dependency receipt.
claims.observed_evidence: Draft and comparison verification recomputed results from direct verified inputs; an adversarial verifier requesting a non-dependency input was rejected and the run failed.

claims.pass_condition: Malformed produced bytes fail even when the executor reports every claim as true.
claims.counterevidence: Executor facts cause malformed bytes to receive PASS or be written as verified output.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Step receipts retain FAIL evidence from the separately identified content verifier.
claims.observed_evidence: A replacement executor returned malformed JSON plus all-true claim facts; both bounded attempts failed and no claim passed.

claims.pass_condition: The Hand renders an exact release note from a locked brief and the verifier recomputes draft and intent bindings from bytes.
claims.primary_surface: Three-package external candidate run plus exact output comparison
claims.counterevidence: A brief field is omitted, a heading differs, the draft digest differs, or publication is reported.
claims.observed_evidence: The candidate reached CANDIDATE_READY; written markdown matched the deterministic rendering, a distinct verifier parser rejected semantically altered content, and every claim cited artifact-content inspection.

claims.pass_condition: A human or appointed documentation reviewer accepts clarity, usefulness, tone, and completeness for a representative real release.
claims.primary_surface: Human review of representative release notes
claims.counterevidence: Structurally correct output is confusing, misleading, or unsuitable for its audience.
claims.observed_evidence: No human editorial review was requested or performed.

claims.pass_condition: An untrusted Hand or verifier cannot access filesystem, process, or network resources outside its declared capability envelope.
claims.primary_surface: Host-level denied-capability tests in an isolated process sandbox
claims.counterevidence: In-process code directly imports Node APIs or accesses undeclared host resources.
claims.observed_evidence: v0.1 uses a trusted in-process registry; only the provided readers are bounded.
